question: By calendar year, how many years passed from his becoming head of advanced development at Standard Telephones and Cables to his retirement from that company?
criterion: dated employment milestones with an organisation: joining it, taking a senior post at it, or retiring from it (an internal move between research stations is excluded)
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách chỉ có nghĩa khi có hai mốc việc làm được nêu tên, nên câu cần đúng hai mốc.
